title: Review: feat(backend): S3-compatible object storage backend
notes:
Maintainer risk: LOW — S3 is well-understood, the only real correctness issue is the probe path. No security holes. Duplicate function is a minor maintenance burden.
Confidence: 90% chance no missed bug. Uncertainty driven by: S3 provider differences (some providers return 200 for PUT on a missing bucket; startup probe might not catch all misconfigurations). Would raise confidence if: probe exercises the actual prefix path.
